description: None of the Search index-lifecycle task pages (clone, delete, edit, create-index-alias) or the managerOptions REST endpoint state a required role or privilege for the operation they document - a gap present in the server/7.2/fts/ versions of these exact pages and carried unchanged into server/8.0/fts/, across three major releases, despite the rest of the corpus's RBAC documentation being read and corrected multiple times in the interim.
